appearance.guestAppearance: The appearance of the experience is saved separately from the logged-in user’s selections.
appearance.deviceScope: This device only · Applies to all drives and scores
appearance.automaticTheme: Automatically switch between light and dark interfaces
appearance.noteColorsHelp: This changes how inverted pages look. Saving and exporting keep the original colors.
appearance.inversionHelp: Inverting color will also change the color content and cover of the original score; you can switch back to the original if necessary.
appearance.unsaved: The appearance has taken effect in this use, but cannot be saved to this machine.

reloadPrompt.savingCurrentVersion: Still running {current}. The selected version will be prepared once your choice is confirmed.
reloadPrompt.preparedVersion: The version is ready. Switching will start once all windows are safe to reload.
reloadPrompt.selectionPending: Your choice was saved. The switch is still pending. You can check for updates again.
reloadPrompt.switchAdvice: Switching reloads this page. Save your work in other windows first. Your notes and offline content are kept.
reloadPrompt.readyAdvice: The app will reload when it is safe. You can also close every Same Page window and reopen the app.
reloadPrompt.checkAdvice: The update will be prepared when you are online and applied when all windows are safe to reload.
reloadPrompt.otherWindowsAdvice: If Same Page is also open in your browser, return those tabs to the library or close them.
reloadPrompt.safeRecoveryAdvice: Updating does not require clearing local data. If the update fails, use the standalone diagnostics page.

connectionControl.title: Connection lines
connectionControl.backupSiteNote: It is currently a backup website, and the local draft is saved separately from the original website.
connectionControl.sampleLimits: · It only represents each detection and does not mean continuous availability.
connectionControl.sampleLegend: Solid dots indicate success, hollow dots indicate failure or timeout, and gray dots indicate that they have not been detected yet; they are arranged in order of detection, with varying intervals.
connectionControl.sampleUnreachable: Temporarily unable to connect (failure or timeout)
connectionControl.noSamples: The test has not been completed yet.
connectionControl.resolveConflict: Please check your login on another website, log out of a different login and restore the connection. Do not clear site data, unsynced drafts will still be retained.
connectionControl.confirmLogin: This line cannot confirm login at the moment, please click "Restore Connection".
connectionControl.availabilityNote: Neither line guarantees stable access within mainland China.
connectionControl.troubleshooting: You can try switching Wi-Fi or mobile networks; if there is already a VPN available, you can also try opening it. The panel will be automatically detected when it is opened; when you need to reconfirm your login, you can click "Restore Connection".

diagnosticReportForm.copyFailed: Unable to copy automatically, please select the diagnostic information or feedback number to copy manually.
diagnosticReportForm.description: What problem did you encounter just now? (optional)
diagnosticReportForm.placeholder: For example: after opening the score, when turning to the second page, it always displays Loading...
diagnosticReportForm.descriptionHelp: Can describe the operating steps and phenomena observed. Please do not fill in passwords, verification codes, invitation codes or private content.
diagnosticReportForm.privacy: Sending feedback includes device and error details to help us troubleshoot. Sheet music, notes, and sign-in credentials are never uploaded automatically. You can send feedback even if no errors were recorded.
diagnosticReportForm.investigation: Maintenance personnel will investigate based on the diagnostic information. This page does not currently support viewing the processing progress or receiving replies.
diagnosticReportForm.contact: If you need to contact maintenance personnel through existing channels, you can provide this number for easy search.
diagnosticReportForm.keepOpen: Please keep this page open before sending. Refreshing or closing the web page will clear the content to be sent. If the sending fails, you can try again without affecting the score and local draft.
diagnosticReportForm.payload: Includes up to 50 errors in the last 30 minutes, application version, browser and system version, window size, and network/PWA status; in-reader feedback also includes display mode, editing status, and number of pending synchronization/conflicts. Leave unknown information blank, and the network prompt does not mean that the service is reachable.
diagnosticReportForm.diagnosticData: Diagnostic information that can be sent to maintenance personnel

diagnosticSubmission.prepareFailed: Unable to prepare feedback at the moment, please copy the existing diagnostic information.
diagnosticSubmission.deleted: This feedback has been deleted by the maintenance staff, please fill in another feedback.
diagnosticSubmission.throttled: Sent too frequently, please try again later. Current feedback remains and can be copied.
diagnosticSubmission.sentLegacy: has been sent to Same Page maintenance personnel, and the old service will be retained for 30 days.
diagnosticSubmission.unconfirmed: Not yet confirmed receipt of feedback. The current content remains and can be retried or copied; retrying will not create duplicate feedback.
diagnosticSubmission.offlineUnconfirmed: Currently offline, no feedback has been confirmed. Please connect to the Internet and try again, or you can copy the current content; retrying will not create feedback again.

diagnosticsPage.title: Problem feedback
diagnosticsPage.heading: What didn’t go well?
diagnosticsPage.intro: If you encounter any problems when reading music, taking notes or practicing, you can tell us.
diagnosticsPage.help: Frequently asked questions and recovery suggestions
diagnosticsPage.troubleshooting: If there is a network failure, please connect to the network and try again; if permission is denied, please log in again or contact the drive owner; please handle note conflicts in the reader. Do not clear site data for troubleshooting purposes to avoid losing unsynced drafts.

androidInstallOption.choose: Two installation methods, just choose one
androidInstallOption.addIcon: Add it directly to the desktop and click the icon to open it next time.
androidInstallOption.apkDescription: Download the installation package and follow the phone prompts to complete the installation.
androidInstallOption.permission: Follow the system prompts to allow this installation. The score still requires a compatible browser to run; the score will not be automatically downloaded after installation.
androidInstallOption.signIn: If you need to log in again after opening, use the original login method. Native notes and offline scores from other browsers are not transferred automatically.

installCompletion.submitted: The add request was sent. Return to your home screen and tap the Same Page icon.
installCompletion.missingIcon: Can’t find the Same Page icon on your home screen?
installCompletion.shortcutPermission: Open phone settings → Applications → Current browser → Permissions / Other permissions and allow "Create desktop shortcuts" (if available).
installCompletion.tryAgain: After allowing, return to the browser menu and try "Add to Home Screen" or "Install App" again. Skip without this permission.
installCompletion.switchBrowser: Still not showing up? You can try changing browsers. Chrome installation may also be affected by Google Play Services or the network.
installCompletion.checkAdded: Check whether you have clicked "Add" in the system window. You can also go back to the browser and follow the adding steps again.

installEntry.addApp: Add Same Page to your home screen
installEntry.dismiss: Not used for the time being, close installation suggestions
installEntry.rehearse: Next time you rehearse, click the icon to open it.
installEntry.signInAfterSwitch: The drive entrance has been reserved; you may need to log in again or use the original invitation after changing the browser.
installEntry.linkFailed: The link cannot be prepared at the moment, please try again.
installEntry.copied: Link copied. Open it in your browser.
installEntry.copyManually: Please press and hold or select the URL below to copy.

installPage.expired: The link has expired or is invalid. Please go back to the original drive and click "Add to Desktop" again.
installPage.resumeFailed: The drive cannot be retrieved temporarily, please try again. You can also return to the original drive to continue reading the score.
installPage.rehearse: Next time you rehearse, click on the icon to open it
installPage.signInAfterSwitch: The drive entry has been reserved. After switching to a browser, you may need to log in again or use the original invitation.
installPage.resume: After the browser is opened, the current drive will be retrieved. No need to search for invitations again.
installPage.localNotes: The notes you tried to write will remain in the current app and will not be transferred with this addition.
installPage.openApp: After adding it, return to the desktop and click the score icon to open the drive.
installPage.optionMissing: Don’t see the add option? For iPhone/iPad, you can use Safari's share menu; for Android, you can try changing browsers.
installPage.iconMissing: There is no icon after Android is added? Find the permissions of the current browser in the system settings to allow "Create desktop shortcuts" (if any). Chrome installation may also be affected by Google Play Services or the network.
installPage.launched: Same Page is now open as an app. You can keep reading your music.

installProvider.cancelled: Installation canceled. You can continue to use Same Page and check the installation method from the menu later.
installProvider.promptFailed: The installation window cannot be opened temporarily, please follow the steps below to add it.
installProvider.rehearse: Next time you rehearse, you can open it in just one click
installProvider.intro: Add to desktop and start rehearsing anytime.
installProvider.useSafari: Open it in Safari first, then add it to the desktop.
installProvider.useBrowser: Open it in the browser first, and then add it to the desktop.
installProvider.safariHelp: No “Add to Home Screen”? Scroll down the share menu or add in Edit Actions; or try again in Safari.
installProvider.androidHelp: No icon after adding? Go to the phone settings to find the current browser → Permissions/Other Permissions, look for "Create desktop shortcut" and allow it; there is no such item to skip.
installProvider.switchBrowser: Still unable to add, you can try using another browser. Chrome installation may be affected by Google Play Services or the network.
installProvider.openApp: After adding it, return to your home screen and tap the Same Page icon.

installSteps.appMenuHelp: Open the menu of the current App.

installSteps.homeScreenHelp: Look down in the share menu for this option.
installSteps.confirmHelp: If there is "Open as Web App", keep it enabled.

installSteps.installAndroidHelp: Select the visible options and confirm according to the system prompts.
installSteps.installDesktop: Click the install icon in the address bar
installSteps.installDesktopHelp: Chrome/Edge The installation option is also available in the browser menu.
installSteps.safariDock: Mac Safari: File → Add to Dock
installSteps.launch: Confirm, then open the app from the Same Page icon.
